summary: End-to-end tested the new Free Notary Services feature. Backend stub endpoints (POST /api/notary-requests validates name+phone; GET /api/admin/notary-requests returns []) all pass (6/6 pytest). Frontend public flow works — 'Free Notary Services' link visible in desktop AND mobile nav, /notary route renders notary-page + hero + 3 info tiles + full form; valid submission produces success card with 'Request Received' and 'Submit another request' resets the form; empty submits are blocked. Admin login (zwatson) succeeds; admin-tab-notary is present, clickable, and reveals admin-notary-panel with 'No notary requests yet' empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx generates React hydration warnings ('<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' / '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>') visible in console. Cause is the visual-editor injecting extra <span> wrappers around table rows/bodies (x-ve-dynamic). Pre-existing across all admin tabs — not specific to the Notary tab — but worth flagging.
Pre-existing console error: GET .../admin/today-summary returns 404 ('Error fetching today summary: AxiosError'). Unrelated to Notary feature but should be addressed.
server.py stub_notary_create(payload: dict) accepts any keys; consider a Pydantic model in the FastAPI stub for parity with the Cloudflare Worker (low priority — stub only).
In Notary.jsx handleSubmit both HTML5 'required' AND JS validation are used, which is defensive and correct; however toast.error branches will only fire if HTML5 validation is bypassed. Not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Notary feature checks pass — desktop nav, mobile nav, page render, form submit, success card, reset, admin tab & empty panel)

seed_data_creation: None (POST /api/notary-requests is a MOCKED preview stub — echoes only, does not persist). Backend/admin list is expected to remain empty in preview.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notary Services stubs live in /app/backend/server.py (~L173-190). Production persistence lives in Cloudflare Worker /app/cloudflare-backend/src/index.ts (D1 + Resend email) — not exercised here. Admin table pre-existing React hydration warnings (span/tr nesting from visual-editor injections) are unrelated to this feature but pollute the console.

verified_endpoints.notes: Echoes payload with id + status='new' + created_at

mocked_api_note: MOCKED: POST /api/notary-requests (echo only, no persistence) and GET /api/admin/notary-requests (always []) in the preview FastAPI backend. Real persistence + Resend email happens only in the production Cloudflare Worker.
